name: Adultery
description: The act of voluntary sexual intercourse between a person and another character who is not their established spouse or partner.

name: Affection
description: The act of providing the sensations of tenderness and fondness, having characters express such feelings with one another through endearing behaviors.

name: Babysitter
description: A situation in which one character will either be or roleplay as another character's babysitter.

name: Bad Ends
description: A scenario where a character doesn't necessarily have to face death, but is presented with an unfortunate and inevitable future. May involve situations where a character is forced to submit to an undesired opposition or is trapped in a dangerous scenario where there is no escape.

name: Competition
description: Pertains to multiple dominants competing to administer domination the best, or multiple submissives competing to please a dominant the best.

name: Consensual
description: A preference for sexual interactions between characters in an RP to be fully consenting, by their characters' own free wills.

name: Cuckolding
description: A scenario in which one partner is complicit in their partner's infidelity and derives sexual pleasure from it. Generally consists of watching their established partner have sexual relations with another individual, often where the other is considered to be “better” than them, but not necessarily.

name: Dating
description: Engaging in an RP where characters go on a date.

name: Dub-Consensual
description: Denotes situations of "dubious consent," where the receiver either claims denial, uncertainty, or is unclear in their agreement. Typically denotes secretly enjoying what is occurring. May involve the character struggling with the personal internal conflict of unsureness. Often sexual, but can be applied to a variety of circumstances.

name: Exhibitionism
description: Engaging in some kind of play where one or both parties will be caught, spotted, or otherwise observed by a third party or parties, adding to the thrill (and / or humiliation).

name: Fantasy
description: Themes consisting of the fantasy genre, involving magic or other supernatural elements as a main plot element, theme, or setting. Magic and magical creatures are commonly incorporated.

name: Fighting / Wrestling
description: The act of physically sparring, either with malice or more playfully, with another character in an RP; typically non-sexual, although sometimes with the intent to pin the bottom or submissive in order to penetrate them.

name: Horror
description: Themes consisting of the horror genre, incorporating aspects that are considered creepy, macabre, scary, or unsettling (typically to elicit a physiological reaction) as a main plot element, theme, or setting.

name: Humor / Comedy
description: Expresses an interest in the inclusion of humorous dialogue, settings, or situations.

name: Incest
description: Engaging in an RP in which at least two characters will be related, either by blood or by marriage.

name: Incest (Parental)
description: Involves relationships where the characters are blood related in terms of being parent and child.

name: Incest (Siblings)
description: Involves relationships where the characters are blood related in terms of being siblings.

name: Inexperienced Partners
description: Refers to players whose characters are sexually inexperienced and / or naive (typically younger or virgin characters), or an interest in RPing with such characters; does not refer to the RPing capabilities of the player.

name: Infantilism
description: A scenario in which a character (be they adult or otherwise) will be treated as if they are exceptionally young; typically implies diaper wearing and / or diaper usage. Tends to include rather infantile themes and aspects.

name: Informality
description: Treating sexual acts, having explicit dialogue or reacting to predetermined kinks casually, or as if they were normal in their setting.

name: Kidnapping
description: The act of abducting a character in an RP, (typically for the purpose of abusing, usually sexually, but not necessarily) or being abducted for such reasons; often implies indefinite imprisonment.

name: Medical Play
description: Engaging in an RP set in a medical setting, such as a hospital, or an RP involving aspects of medicine, such as injections, medical equipment, uniforms or medical experiments or procedures.

name: Military Themes
description: Expresses an interest in scenes, settings, and themes that incorporate military aspects. Implies concepts such as war, weapon involvement, uniforms, rank, and more. All of which may be historical, fantasy, scifi or otherwise.

name: Modern Settings
description: Themes consisting of the modern aspects, taking place in current times. Often implies up to date technology and culture.

name: Multiple Partners
description: Engaging in an RP containing at least three characters.

name: Nightclubs / Bars
description: Engaging in an RP which is set in a nightclub or a bar setting.

name: Nonconsensual
description: Engaging in an RP in which a character will be forced to give or receive sex against their will by another character.

name: Parent and Child Play
description: Describes a kind of relationship where the dominant assumes the role of a parent. This usually involves the dominant party being especially caring, nurturing and protective towards their sub. Conditioning and guidance are often involved as well.

name: Photography / Videotaping
description: The act of visually recording a scene amongst participants, often as a form of humiliation, exhibitionist fetishism and / or blackmail / extortion.

name: Polyamory
description: The practice of carrying out intimate relationships with more than one partner, with the knowledge and consent of all involved partners. Often described as "consensual, ethical, and responsible non-monogamy."

name: Prostitution
description: Engaging in an RP in which at least one player's character is a prostitute, or involves a prostitute; a person who receives money for sex.

name: Pseudo-rape
description: Arousal from a partner who pretends to resist and to struggle before being overpowered.

name: Racism
description: Scenes based on / including negative racial stereotypes, scenes in racist settings, differing treatment depending on a character’s given race, and possible usage of derogatory terms in the context of a roleplay.

name: Realism
description: Expresses an interest in roleplaying scenes that are realistically possible by real life standards, or at the very least applying sensible logic and reason to situations, character responses, and motivations.

name: Roleplay within RP
description: Expresses an interest in two or more characters taking on roles within an RP and acting out a predetermined scene with predetermined characters.

name: Role Reversal
description: Refers to characters that, within the context of a particular RP, have, through character development or pre-determined measures, established their identity in regard to dominance and / or submissiveness, that will, at some point during the sexual portion of the RP, reverse their roles in regard to their previously understood roles.

name: Romance
description: Displaying or expressing love or strong affection, passion, either during love making or during normal scenes. Typically involves the roleplaying of romantic relationships, acts, and themes.

name: Scenes - Dungeon
description: Engaging in an RP which is set in a BDSM dungeon.

name: Scenes - Laboratory
description: Engaging in an RP in which the setting is of a laboratorial nature.

name: Scenes - Locker Room
description: Engaging in an RP in which the setting is a locker room.

name: Scenes - Office
description: Engaging in an RP which is set in an office.

name: Scenes - School
description: Engaging in an RP in which the setting is a school or college.

name: Scenes - Shower / Bath
description: Engaging in an RP in which the setting includes a bath or shower, may be public and / or shared.

name: Scenes - Steampunk
description: Setting in a roleplay where the main power source is steam. The time-period usually appearing as the 19th century, yet containing fantasy / futuristic elements, inventions, and machines often way ahead of it's time.

name: Scenes - Tribal
description: Engaging in an RP set in a tribal village or wild area, located far from civilization.

name: Sci-fi
description: Themes of the science-fiction genre, typically dealing with imaginative concepts such as futuristic science and technology, space travel, time travel, extraterrestrial life, and so on.

name: Sexism
description: Scenes based on prejudices, stereotypes, or discrimination on the basis of sex or gender, including sexist settings.

name: Slice of Life
description: Engaging in scenes of seemingly arbitrary events in a character's life, often lacking plot development and left open ended. Usually consists of naturally occurring themes and narratives that are of the casual and mundane variety.

name: Small Dom / Big Sub
description: Expresses an interest in the bottom / submissive character being physically larger than the top / dominant character in an RP; often implies the larger character is also physically stronger as well.

name: Speciesism
description: Scenes that incorporate addressing another species in a derogatory manner, usually demeaning epithets and / or claiming superiority to another species in the context of a roleplay.

name: STDs
description: Expresses an interest in play that incorporates sexually transmitted diseases, be they ones of real world origin or entirely fictional.

name: Very Experienced Partners
description: Refers to players whose characters are exceptionally experienced and / or skilled in the practice of sex, and typically connotates esoteric sexual abilities and / or knowledge, or the interest in RPing with such characters; does not refer to the RPing capabilities of the player.

name: Voyeurism
description: Participating in watching other individuals engaging in sex or some other kind of intercourse, usually discretely and without their knowledge.

name: Weapon Play
description: Expresses an interest in the incorporation of weaponry, such as knives, swords, guns, and various other armaments.

name: World of Warcraft
description: Roleplay taking place in the World of Warcraft universe.

name: Zoophilia
description: Refers to a sapient character engaging in a sexual act with a non-sapient animal, or playing a non-sapient animal in an RP and being engaged by a sapient character.

name: Teacher/Student Roleplay
description: Teacher-and-student power dynamic.

name: Boss/Employee Roleplay
description: Workplace power dynamic.

name: Public/Semi-Public Play
description: Sex in public, discreetly.

name: Threesomes
description: Sex involving three people.

name: Partner Voyeurism
description: One partner watches the other.

name: Consensual Non-Consent
description: Pre-negotiated roleplay of non-consent.

name: Rape Play
description: Roleplay of a non-consenting partner.
